first_step_test: The first crop establishes one complete diagonal tube with its crimped tail and fixed capped nozzle, so later details can be placed on a stable silhouette.

source.notes: Approved fourth generated sheet after focused removal of two highlight outlines from Step 3; V1 count mismatch, V2 cap movement, V3 crease disappearance, and V4 highlight erasure remain private. Raw approved sheet and square crop source remain in drafts.

final_elements.name: tapered tube body
final_elements.description: One long gently squeezed tube silhouette running upper left to lower right with a reserved narrow gap for the cap.

final_elements.name: crimped tail
final_elements.description: A short folded seam attached across the upper-left end of the tube body.

final_elements.name: ribbed cap
final_elements.description: One small cap attached at the lower-right nozzle gap with three vertical ribs.

final_elements.name: front label panel
final_elements.description: One rounded rectangular label panel centered inside the tube silhouette.

final_elements.name: paint drop emblem
final_elements.description: One simple teardrop shape centered inside the label panel.

final_elements.name: broken ground shadow
final_elements.description: One short broken shadow under and to the right of the capped tube.

frames.visible_job: Set the long tilted tube, crimped tail, and attached ribbed cap at their final anchors.
frames.instruction: With black felt tip, draw one long tapered squeezed tube diagonally from upper left to lower right. Close its broad end with a folded crimp; at the narrow lower-right tip, attach a small squared cap with exactly three short ribs.

frames.visible_job: Add the central rounded label panel and its one drop emblem.
frames.instruction: Inside the broad middle of the fixed tube, draw one rounded rectangular label following its tilt. Center one teardrop emblem inside, keeping a paper gap between the label and the tube edge.

frames.visible_job: Add one short broken black shadow directly below the capped end.
frames.instruction: Below the lower-right cap, place one short broken black shadow. Keep the crimp, three cap ribs, label, and drop fixed; leave the red body blank until the color step.

final_step.visible_job: Fill the established tube, cap, and drop with bright marker strokes while preserving the label and small white highlight.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established tube coral red, the label warm yellow, the single drop turquoise, and the cap deep violet. Leave two narrow shine streaks and one tiny shine spot as open paper on the tube, show directional marker strokes, and preserve the existing shadow and black contours.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The saved first crop establishes one long tilted squeezed tube with a broad attached crimp, narrow nozzle collar, squared cap, and exactly three cap ribs at the final positions. The blank tube front gives a simple connected starting silhouette.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: The three saved transitions add a single label and drop, ground the cap with a broken shadow, then fill the same shapes with bright marker and reserve small white shines. Each existing outline and attachment persists; no temporary guides appear or disappear.

transitions.observed_addition: One rounded rectangular panel appears on the broad middle of the already capped diagonal tube, and one separate teardrop contour appears inside. The crimped tail, nozzle collar, squared cap, and all three cap ribs remain in their initial positions.
transitions.instruction_match: The Step 2 instruction asks for the centered label and single drop. The saved crop shows those additions while the tube body remains blank.

transitions.observed_addition: One broken black ground shadow appears immediately beneath the same capped lower-right end. The label, drop, crimp, tube sides, collar, and three cap ribs remain fixed; no interior shine contour appears.
transitions.instruction_match: The Step 3 instruction asks the reader only to ground the tube with a short broken shadow, exactly the new mark visible in this crop.

transitions.observed_addition: Coral, yellow, turquoise, and violet marker fills cover the established tube, label, single drop, and cap. Two narrow white streaks and one tiny shine spot are reserved during coloring, while the earlier black shadow and every structural contour persist.
transitions.instruction_match: The finish follows the named palette and adds only allowed small paper highlights during the color pass; the cap still has exactly three dark ribs and no earlier keeper line disappears.
